[00:00] HOST: Welcome to Slow Boats. Today we are in a boatyard in Stoke with Marta Okonkwo, who restores old canal boats.
[01:10] MARTA: I started eleven years ago, with a wooden butty boat that had sunk twice.
[04:35] HOST: What was the hardest part of that first restoration?
[04:50] MARTA: The elm baseboard. Nobody sells elm planks any more, so I had to find a fallen tree.
[09:15] HOST: How long did the whole job take?
[09:25] MARTA: Three years of weekends. I would not do it again without a team.
[14:05] HOST: Any advice for someone starting out?
[14:20] MARTA: Buy the survey first. A boat with rot in the keelson is not worth saving.
[16:40] HOST: Marta, thank you. That was Slow Boats.
